scope: Four core original studies for references 32–35, plus optional harmonic-network background reference 36; no experiments or DOCX edits

citations.title: Extensive Conformational Heterogeneity within Protein Cores
citations.journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry B
citations.verification_level: Publisher metadata/abstract and search-returned original PMC full-text Results section, including entropy construction and Figure 2 caption; direct PMC open was challenged
supported_claims: Folded proteins, including core residues, sample multiple side-chain rotamer conformations
Assigning each angle to gauche+/gauche-/trans and counting complete angle combinations permits a joint side-chain Shannon entropy
Side-chain population entropy and rotamer transition times were separately calculated
evidence_locations: Results and Discussion / Liquid-Like Behavior of Side Chains within Protein Cores
citations.application: Closest original precedent for joint angle-state entropy and the distribution/time distinction
citations.precision_note: Paper uses rotamer states; its exact numerical bin boundaries were not established from the returned section. Do not claim identity to FlexPPI's frozen interval boundaries.

citations.title: The Dynameomics rotamer library: amino acid side chain conformations and dynamics from comprehensive molecular dynamics simulations in water
citations.verification_level: Author-institution original PDF full text, Figure 2 definitions and Materials and Methods explicitly read; PMC metadata cross-checked
supported_claims: Rotamer bins are separated at predicted energy maxima rather than canonical minima
Figure 2 tetrahedral-carbon definition uses 0° and ±120° boundaries
Specific terminal dihedrals require alternative definitions; dynamics uses 0°/180° bins for Asn/Asp/His/Phe/Tyr chi2 and Gln/Glu chi3
Occupancies and transition correlation times are separate analyses
evidence_locations: Figure 2, printed p.344, definition #1 and notes
Materials and Methods / Conformational analyses, printed pp.350–351
Materials and Methods / Dynamics analyses, printed p.351
Dihedral angle energy minima, printed pp.342–343
citations.application: Direct basis for the conventional non-Pro chi1 reference partition and periodic/special-angle handling
citations.precision_note: Pro chi1 is associated with ring pucker around ±30° and a special 0°-based definition. A uniform 60° shift of all chi angles is not a complete physical rotamer correction. Issue year is 2011.

citations.title: Hidden Regularity and Universal Classification of Fast Side Chain Motions in Proteins
citations.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
citations.verification_level: Publisher original metadata and abstract plus PubMed original record; paid full text not obtained
supported_claims: ABF-enhanced sampling of eight proteins produced 618 side-chain free-energy surfaces
Rotamer populations, conformational entropy, probability flux and activation energies were separately analyzed
citations.application: Supports studying the relation between side-chain populations/entropy and local free-energy landscapes
citations.precision_note: Do not attribute a binning implementation to this paper based only on the abstract. Preserve the publisher's displayed first-author name.

citations.title: Coordinate-dependent diffusion in protein folding
citations.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
citations.verification_level: Original PMC full-text sections returned in targeted primary-source search, including the projected Smoluchowski equation and coordinate transformations; PubMed metadata cross-checked
supported_claims: Projected free-energy profiles and diffusion coefficients depend on the chosen coordinate
Monotonic coordinate transforms modify the free-energy profile through a Jacobian term
Folding kinetics involve both the profile and a diffusion-dependent prefactor
evidence_locations: Results / Dependence of D on Q
General Relation Between Diffusion on Different Coordinates
citations.application: Concrete support for separating empirical projected density profiles from kinetics and for defining the plotted coordinate
citations.precision_note: Cite year 2010, not the 2009 online date. F*=-ln(p/pmax) in this analysis is an explicitly defined empirical density-derived statistic, not a landscape predicted by FlexPPI.

citations.title: Direct evaluation of thermal fluctuations in proteins using a single-parameter harmonic potential
citations.verification_level: Publisher original abstract and author-institution PDF first-page metadata returned in search; full PDF open unavailable
supported_claims: A local harmonic elastic-network potential can predict residue fluctuations and cross-correlations about reference positions
citations.precision_note: Local harmonic-network fluctuations concern the neighborhood of a structure. This paper is not a residue barrier-inversion study.

method_definitions.profile_zero: Most populated density bin has F_star=0
method_definitions.units: Dimensionless empirical F/(kBT) scale; no assumed numerical temperature and no kcal/mol conversion
method_definitions.state_relative_free_energy_if_equilibriu: (F_B-F_A)/(kBT) = -ln(p_B/p_A); state probabilities are integrated masses and should not be confused with continuous density values
method_definitions.frozen_target_preservation: Do not replace the complete joint target. Compute non-Pro chi1 marginal entropies for binning sensitivity and label them separately.
method_definitions.entropy_probability_identity: For the same discrete-state partition, H=-sum(p_i ln p_i) is the probability-weighted mean of -ln p_i; this is an algebraic identity, not a learned barrier mapping.
method_definitions.main_use: Pair frozen OOF predictions with trajectory distribution shape and binning sensitivity; empirical landscapes come from MD coordinates rather than model-predicted RMSF/Hchi.
